title: Find Users with Persistent Behavior Patterns
summary: Find runs of at least five consecutive dates on which a user performs exactly one action and that action is constant; for each user choose the longest run, then lexicographically smallest action, then latest start date; return user_id, action, streak_length, start_date, end_date sorted by length descending then user_id ascending.
inputFormat: activity(user_id int, action_date date, action text), unique by all three fields.
officialConstraints: user_id integer; action_date date; action text.
tieRules: Longest run, then lexicographically smallest action, then latest start date.
edgeRules: A date with more than one action type breaks a run.
